svg.title: Input returns DataFrame for the realized volatility test
svg.desc: A 100-row, 2-column DataFrame of seeded random daily returns for SPY and QQQ both scaled by the same named constant daily_sigma equal to 0.01, indexed by business days starting January 2 2024, with the daily_sigma value shown as a code annotation above the table emphasizing that both tickers share the same volatility so the test produces a single clean reference value for the annualization sanity check.

g.text: named constant ≈ 1% typical daily move — reused for both columns

svg.text: Both columns share daily_sigma → both should produce the same annualized vol: 0.01 × √252 ≈ 0.159.
In the momentum test QQQ used 0.012 (higher tech vol). Here, the same sigma gives one clean reference value to check.
